author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Client shorthand navigation duplicates the canonical author-prefix normalization policy locally.
findings.consequence: If the internal-navigation canonical prefix policy changes, shorthand redirects can drift from the rest of the application and produce a router target with different encoding than other Nuxt author links. Current behavior is covered for the existing /författare prefix, so this is a maintainability risk rather than a confirmed runtime defect.
findings.evidence: Line 98 rewrites /^\/författare(?=\/)/ to /f%C3%B6rfattare inside the page. The same route-domain policy already exists in app/lib/internal-navigation.ts as canonicalNuxtHref, with authorPrefixes covering /forfattare, /författare, and /f%C3%B6rfattare while preserving query and fragment text.
findings.recommendation: Import and use canonicalNuxtHref(publicTarget) when computing the client router target, keeping this page responsible for resolver validation and raw suffix preservation but leaving author-prefix canonicalization to the shared navigation utility.
